title: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Supervision of Judicial Administrative Affairs, etc.)
(1) Judges to serve in an outlying division of a High Court shall be determined by the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court.
(2) The Chief Justice may designate one judge belonging to an outlying division to supervise its judicial administrative affairs.
(3) The President of the High Court may delegate to the judge designated under paragraph (2) authority concerning judicial administrative affairs of the relevant outlying division to the extent necessary.
